integrity: Complete recomputable enumeration, all 15 sector distance distributions crosschecked by independently encoded implementations; numeric results have not undergone independent scholarly audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact census only for the untwisted 4-by-6 toroidal grid and its 24 elementary-face flips; no new general component criterion or pairwise height-distance formula is claimed. A related 1995 paper supplies general component and distance methods; its full text, a 2014 toroidal matching paper, and a 2023 toroidal flip paper were inspected. Equivalent finite tables could exist in unindexed work. Reproducibility uses two nonindependent-from-the-mathematical-definition implementations; independent external validation has not occurred.
title: Complete winding-sector flip metric of domino tilings on the \(4\times6\) torus
